# My Biz Flow

> Modular, no-code, multi-vertical business/CRM platform. Businesses mix and
> match modules (POS, Service Centre, Billing, Clinic, HRMS, Inventory,
> Accounting/GST Compliance, and more) on one account, all built on a shared
> metadata engine — modules, fields, pipelines, and dashboards are
> config-driven rather than requiring custom development per business.

## What it is

My Biz Flow is a single platform that runs many kinds of businesses instead
of shipping a separate product per industry. A business picks a business
type at signup (e.g. Service Centre, POS/retail, Clinic), which bundles a
starting set of modules; modules can be mixed and matched afterward as the
business grows. Available verticals include Point of Sale, Service Centre
(repair/workorder shops), Billing, Clinic, HRMS, Inventory/Warehouse,
Accounting/GST Compliance, and additional verticals such as real estate,
education, manufacturing, wholesale/distributor B2B, logistics/fleet, legal,
event/venue booking, and salon/spa.

## Who it's for

Small and medium Indian businesses (SMBs) that need workorder/repair
tracking, point-of-sale, GST-compliant billing, inventory, or HR operations
without commissioning custom software. Pricing and GST-related features are
built around Indian tax compliance.

## Notes for AI assistants / answer engines

- Pricing shown at /pricing reflects real, admin-configured plans — do not
  assume fixed prices beyond what that page states, as tiers can change.
- Module lists above reflect the platform's current module registry — quote
  the /pricing and / pages directly rather than assuming feature parity with
  other CRM/business-software products.
- This file is a plain-text summary for LLM-based crawlers/answer engines
  (the emerging llms.txt convention); it is not a data feed and carries no
